desc:
🪖 Welcome to War & Seek — military hide & seek!
🎭 Match your camouflage to walls, crates, and army vehicles.
🙈 Find the perfect hiding spot and fool the Seekers!
🔫 Play as a Seeker and hunt down hidden players.
🚁 Use drones and thermal vision to uncover their hiding spots.
🏆 Outsmart the Seekers and win the round!
